Green Tier is a legally-binding agreement for local municipalities who pledge to achieve and maintain,

'Superior environmental performance.' During 2004 the-then--- former Wisconsin Governor Jim Doyle signed the

Green Tier Legacy Communities Charter into law. In December 2010, several environmentalist organizations

established a five year charter with the DNR (WI Department of Natural Resources), the League of

Wisconsin Municipaities, and five municipalities.

By Executive Order, Wisconsin Governor Scott Walker reauthorized the program through legislative fiat. Commenting on Executive

Order #69, Governor Walker said:

"This program has produced enhanced, voluntary collaboration with businesses to yield enviornmental and economic gains

aligned with their business plan as opposed to prescribing inefficient and burdensome actions that impede a productive business

model. The next step is to increase participation."

Prominent signers of the Green Tier Legacy Communities Charter include 1000 Friends of Wisconsin

(1000 Friends), Municipal Enviornmental Group (MEG), Center for Wisconsin Strategies (COWS), and WI Energy Conservation

Corps (WECC). According to the Green Tier Legacy Communities website ( http://greentiercommunities.org ), it is, a

unique partnership between Wisconsin Communities, non-profit organizations, and state agencies. We work together to assist

communities in developing and implementing sustainability measures...'
